name: NMS Global Limited
about: NMS Global Limited engages in consultancy, skill development, infrastructure, and payroll-related businesses in India. It provides trading and consultancy services in contractual fields, such as civil construction, pre-engineered buildings, skill development, financial consultancy, engineering services, publication, manpower hiring, and advertising. The company was formerly known as NMS Resources Global Limited and changed its name to NMS Global Limited in October 2023. NMS Global Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Delhi, India.
